description_en: Rebuilds an instance that has been moved to the recycle bin
description_zh: 该接口用于重建已进入回收站的实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-db-instance-for-rebuild --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --pay-type Postpaid --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBInstanceForRebuild

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the target instance. Valid values:
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的付费类型，取值：
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43185.html of the instance. Separate multiple entries with commas (,). Each entry must be unique. A maximum of 1,000 entries are allowed. The following two formats are supported:
IP address format, such as 10.10.XX.XX.
CIDR format, such as 10.10.XX.XX/24 (Classless Inter-Domain Routing, where 24 indicates the length of the prefix in the address, ranging from 1 to 32).

If you do not specify this parameter, the whitelist of the default group of the original instance is used
parameters.help_zh:
该实例的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43185.html。多条记录请以半角逗号（,）隔开，不可重复，最多1000条记录。支持如下两种格式：
IP地址形式，例如：10.10.XX.XX。
CIDR形式，例如：10.10.XX.XX/24（无类域间路由，24表示了地址中前缀的长度，范围为1~32）。

如不填则默认为原实例default分组白名单信息
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The name of the target instance. The name must be 2 to 256 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character.
The name cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例名称，长度为2~256个字符。以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头
parameters.name: db_instance_description

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID of the primary node. You can call DescribeRegions to query the zone ID.

If you specify a VPC and a vSwitch, you must specify this parameter to match the zone of the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh:
主节点可用区ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用区ID。

指定了VPC和交换机时，为匹配交换机对应的可用区，该参数必填
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The secondary zone 1.
This parameter is required for non-Basic Edition instances
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区1。
非基础系列实例需要传入该参数
parameters.name: zone_id_slave_1

parameters.help_en:
The secondary zone 2.
This parameter is valid only for RDS Enterprise Edition instances
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区2。
仅三节点企业系列实例可传入该参数
parameters.name: zone_id_slave_2

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID of the target instance. This parameter is required when InstanceNetworkType is set to VPC.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the ZoneId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的VPC ID。当InstanceNetworkType=VPC时，本参数必须配置。
如果传入此参数，您还需要传入参数ZoneId
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID. The zone of the vSwitch must be active and match the zone ID specified in ZoneId.

The network type InstanceNetworkType must be set to VPC.
If you specify ZoneSlaveId1 (secondary zone ID), specify two vSwitch IDs and separate them with a comma (,)
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟交换机ID。虚拟交换机所在的可用区必须和ZoneId中传入的可用区ID相对应。

网络类型InstanceNetworkType需为VPC。
若您填写了ZoneSlaveId1（备可用区ID），此处需填写两个交换机ID，并使用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:
Year: yearly subscription.
Month: monthly subscription.

This parameter is required when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
Year：包年。
Month：包月。

若付费类型为Prepaid则该参数必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:
If Period is set to Year, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 5.
If Period is set to Month, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 11.

This parameter is required when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长。取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~5。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~11。

若PayType为Prepaid，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent repeated submissions. The value of this parameter is generated by the client and is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The network connectivity type of the instance. Valid values:
Internet: public network connection.
Intranet: internal network connection
parameters.help_zh:
实例的网络连接类型，取值：
Internet：公网连接。
Intranet：内网连接
parameters.name: db_instance_net_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the target instance. Valid values:

VPC: VPC.
Classic: classic network.

Default value: Classic.
If the instance is a cloud disk instance, this parameter is required and must be set to VPC. If this parameter is set to VPC, you must also specify the VpcId and VSwitchId parameters
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的网络类型，取值：

VPC：VPC网络
Classic：经典网络

默认创建经典网络类型的实例。
当实例为云盘实例时，该参数必填，且值为VPC。当本参数值为VPC时，还需要传入参数VpcId、VSwitchId
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. This parameter can be left empty
parameters.name: resource_group_id
